title: Press ':' right at startup breaks neovim

labels.name: bug-crash
labels.description: issue reporting a crash or segfault

body:
<!-- Before reporting: search existing issues and check the FAQ. -->

- Terminal name/version:
alacritty v0.1.0

### Steps to reproduce
* Start nvim
* Press ':' really quickly
* In the command buffer, the cursor is moved to the right by several character, no ':' is shown
* Press any other key
* Crash
